output.summary: Insufficient field meter reading coverage (route completion below target) leads to missed reads, causing estimation and incorrect bills, which drives the increase in dispute tickets. [E-02][E-03][E-04] This is shown by higher disputed bills for actual reads [E-02], dispute ticket volume doubling since August [E-03], and route completion measured at 0.88 versus the 0.95 target [E-04]. The release scope included optimizing route scheduling and pushing route updates, but no changes were released due to the hold. Decision: HOLD. The release was held due to a critical VOB-U-U1 intersecting the release scope (optimize_route_scheduling:DA-ROUTE, push_route_update:field-dispatch) [U-U1]. Limitations: The hold cites unfinished work to increase field reader headcount by three FTEs to address staffing shortage [E-05] and raise route completion toward the target of 0.95 [E-04].
